$comment: Names that envUI 0.7 exported and 1.0 does not, by entry point. Each entry's `to` lists what replaces it in 1.0: one name, alternatives, or nothing for a name that became internal, whose `use` says what to do instead. A split (DirectionLink) also has the `prop` whose `values` choose the part. A name that becomes the Root part of its own namespace (Menu -> Menu.Root) stays importable, and so does a removed name that 1.0 reuses as a namespace (`namespace`: the manual Toast; 1.0's Toast holds Toast.Provider); only rendering them as components is reported. scripts/SyncRenames.mjs rewrites this file from the codemods' rename map (packages/codemods/src/maps/v1) whenever that map exists, before every pack; source says where the entries came from.

ActionCard.use: Card with render={<article />}, title, meta and actions; v1-structure rewrites each use.

ActionCardProps.use: CardProps, with title, meta and actions.

ActionGroup.use: Lay actions out with Row and Column: <Row wrap align="center" gap={4}> for a row, with justify="end" for the end of a form, and <Column gap={2}> with fullWidth on each labelled Button for a stacked group. v1-structure and v1-stack rewrite each use.

ActionGroupProps.use: RowProps, with wrap, align, justify and gap, or ColumnProps.

AppShell.use: AppShell is gone. Build the frame on Scaffold: topBar={<TopBar … />}, the navigation forms in navigation={{ bar, rail, drawer }} and the page as its children, as the migration guide's app frame section and the app frame pattern show.

AppShellProps.use: ScaffoldProps and TopBarProps; AppShell is gone. Build the frame on Scaffold: topBar={<TopBar … />}, the navigation forms in navigation={{ bar, rail, drawer }} and the page as its children, as the migration guide's app frame section and the app frame pattern show.

AppShellSkeleton.use: AppShellSkeleton is gone: render the frame's Scaffold with skeleton on its TopBar, Drawer, Rail or Bar and its page's surfaces, over placeholders(count).

AppShellSkeletonProps.use: AppShellSkeleton is gone: the frame, a Scaffold, with skeleton on its parts over placeholders(count), is its loading state.

BrandLogo.use: envUI ships no logos in 1.0: keep the artwork in the application, as an SVG file or a component that draws it with Icon.

BrandLogoProps.use: IconProps, for an application component that draws its artwork with Icon.

Counter.use: Counter is Badge with count in 1.0: <Badge count={value}>, solid in the accent tone; v1-structure rewrites each use.

EmptyState.use: EmptyState is gone: the empty states pattern builds one from a Column with an icon, a Text heading of the level the page's outline needs, a Text sentence and a Button, centred with align="center" where it takes a region's place, and a danger Alert with announce where content failed to load; no codemod rewrites it.

EmptyStateProps.use: EmptyState is gone, with its props: the empty states pattern builds one from Column, Text and Button.

EnvUILogo.use: envUI ships no logos in 1.0: keep the artwork in the application, as an SVG file or a component that draws it with Icon.

EnvUILogoProps.use: IconProps, for an application component that draws its artwork with Icon.

FeatureCard.use: FeatureCard is the feature cards pattern in 1.0: a Card holding a Row with an icon, a Column of Text and a Button; v1-structure reports each use.

FeatureCardProps.use: CardProps; FeatureCard is the feature cards pattern in 1.0, a Card holding a Row of Text and a Button.

LoadingBar.use: TopBar's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along its bottom edge; Progress shows the progress of a task.

LoadingBarProps.use: TopBar's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along its bottom edge; Progress shows the progress of a task.

LoadingState.use: LoadingState is a Spinner with showLabel in 1.0: <Spinner label="…" showLabel />, which says Loading without a label; v1-structure rewrites each use.

MenuDensity.use: Menus have one anatomy in 1.0, and density is gone: the app's scale sizes them, so use ThemeScale for a scale and drop the density.

NavigationItem.use: List the destinations in one array, each { label, icon, href or onSelect, count, group, current }, and pass it to Drawer, Rail or Bar, which render the items; selected is current, a count in end is count. No codemod rewrites it: rewrite each list by hand.

NavigationItemProps.use: Destination, one item of the array that Bar, Rail and Drawer take, or DrawerDestination, whose icon is optional.

OrganizationMenu.use: OrganizationMenu, OrganizationSwitcher in 1.0.0-prerelease.0, is gone: the organization switcher pattern builds it from a Menu.Root whose trigger is a secondary Button naming the active organization, a Menu.RadioGroup of Menu.RadioItems with the person's role as each description, and a Menu.Item that creates one; no codemod rewrites it.

OrganizationMenuOrganization.use: OrganizationSwitcher is gone, with its items: the organization switcher pattern renders the application's own organizations as Menu.RadioItems.

OrganizationMenuProps.use: Menu.RootProps; OrganizationSwitcher is gone: the organization switcher pattern builds it from Menu.Root, Menu.RadioGroup and Button.

PanelDockControls.use: PanelDock.Header shows the window controls itself, with controls={false} to leave them out; their names, Minimize, Maximize, Restore and Close, come from EnvUIProvider's messages.panelDock.

PanelDockControlsProps.use: PanelDock.Header shows the window controls itself; set their names through EnvUIProvider's messages.panelDock.

Skeleton.use: Skeletons are the components themselves in 1.0: put skeleton on the surface that holds the content, such as a Surface, Card, List.Root or Table.Root, and render its normal components over placeholders(count) while the items load; its text becomes bars and its controls filled shapes. For loading with no known shape, a Spinner with showLabel shows a spinner and its label.

SkeletonProps.use: Skeleton is gone: skeleton on a Surface, Card, List.Root, Table.Root and the other containers, over placeholders(count).

Stack.use: Lay out with Row for direction="row" and Column otherwise, with the same gap, align, justify and render; v1-stack rewrites each element.

StackElement.use: Row, Column, Grid, Box, Surface and Text render another element through render, such as render={<section />}; they no longer take as.

Stat.use: Stat is gone: the key figures pattern builds a figure from Text, a muted label and a headline figure in tabular digits, with a Badge that says the trend in words, and a group from a Surface around a Grid; no codemod rewrites it.

StatGroup.use: Stat.Group is gone: the key figures pattern puts the figures in a Surface with role="group" around a Grid of even columns.

StatGroupProps.use: SurfaceProps; Stat.Group is gone: the key figures pattern puts the figures in a Surface around a Grid.

StatProps.use: Stat is gone, with its props: the key figures pattern builds a figure from Text and a Badge.

StatTrend.use: Stat is gone: the key figures pattern says the trend with a Badge, its tone and a trending icon.

StatTrendTone.use: BadgeTone; Stat is gone: the key figures pattern says the trend with a Badge in its tone.

SurfaceDensity.use: Surface's density is gone in 1.0: give the controls inside a ControlSize with their size prop, or set a ThemeScale with scale on a Theme around the region.

TextElement.use: Text renders another element through render, such as render={<h2 />}.

TitleBar.use: TitleBar is gone: <TopBar titleBar start={…} title={…} actions={…} />, with its end content in actions.

TitleBarProps.use: TopBarProps; TitleBar is gone: a TopBar with titleBar is the window's title bar.

Toast.use: Show notifications through useToast() inside Toast.Provider. The manual Toast is internal; the `Toast` export is now the namespace of Toast.Provider.

ToastProps.use: Describe a notification with ToastNotification, the argument of useToast().show().

WindowFrame.use: WindowFrame is gone: a window that draws its title bar is a Scaffold with topBarSpan="full" and topBar={<TopBar titleBar … />}, and bodyRef for scrollRef, as the window frame pattern shows.

WindowFrameProps.use: ScaffoldProps; WindowFrame is gone: a Scaffold with topBarSpan="full" and a TopBar with titleBar frame the window.

getInitials.use: Avatar shows the initials itself with fallback="initials"; derive initials in the application for custom layouts.

useAppShell.use: AppShell is gone: Scaffold's bodyRef is the element that scrolls the page, and sticky content sticks at the top of the body, at 0.

useLinkComponent.use: Render envUI's Link, Button with href, the destinations of Bar, Rail and Drawer, or Menu.Item with href, which use the LinkProvider's component; or read the router's link component in the application.

useSidebarCompact.use: The sidebar is gone: Scaffold shows a navigation Rail of icons in a medium window, chosen by its width in CSS, with no state to read.

defaultThemeStorageKey.use: The default storage key is the string "env-theme"; pass the same storageKey to createThemeBootstrapScript and ThemePreferenceProvider to change it.
